# Inflexion : Marketing for the AI era

Inflexion helps brands win visibility across AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude), the algorithmic retail shelf (Amazon, Instacart, Walmart Connect), and AI-improved media buying.

## Services

- **AEO / Answer Engine Optimisation**: Get cited in AI answers. Prompt set audits, source authority mapping, citation tracking across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude.
- **AI Visibility Analytics**: Cross-model citation testing, share of answer tracking, competitor citation benchmarking.
- **Technical GEO**: Schema, entity signals, structured data and crawler access for AI system comprehension.
- **Digital PR for AEO**: Earn citations in outlets, forums and data sets that AI models may cite.
- **Retail Media**: Algorithmic shelf position tracking, paid/organic separation, multi-retailer strategy.
- **Amazon**: Sponsored Products, Brands, Display and DSP as one system, with product data and review improvements.
- **Beauty Media Strategy**: Strategy for beauty brands navigating AI-assisted shopping, agentic commerce and retail media.
- **AI-Powered Traditional Media**: Algorithmic buying and budget reallocation across display, video and CTV.
- **AI Consultancy**: Operating model redesign, team restructuring for AI-augmented workflows.
- **Data & Measurement**: Multi-surface attribution connecting AI citations, retail rank and campaign data.

## Pricing

Pricing is project-based. Contact hello@inflexion.co for a quote. Baseline audits start from a fixed prompt set run across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude : you keep the data either way.
